title: GitPayBit
tagline: An AI-powered GitHub payment system automates rewards based on contributions. Repo owners set levels (e.g., Level 1, Level 2) for merged PRs. AI suggests levels, tracks progress, and triggers token transfers or approvals. Features include NFT badges and cross-chain payments.
description: I built an AI agent which fetches the persons github profile and analyse it. I am adding other things to it like create a NFT for your profile. create campaign on chain like bounties for your project, AI agent can roast your github profile. For AI agent I used open AI API and provided the agent with tools to find github data of a user, it also cache the user data in mongoDB.
how_its_made: This project I have build using multiple technologies Like LanggraphJs, solidity with hardhat, NextJs for frontend and NextJs backend for github authentication, Nodejs server for creating APIs to interact with AI agent, mongoDB for the database for caching user queries. I have used ethers library in the frontend for interacting with user wallet
